name: zapchat-tests
description: Black-box end-to-end suites that drive the running ZapChat platform through the API gateway.
comment: The SignalR suite needs a real hub client. It is declared here rather than borrowed from ../frontend/node_modules because Node resolves bare ESM imports relative to the importing file, not the working directory — so `cd frontend && node ../tests/signalr-e2e.mjs` could never resolve it.
